name: LAZARUS PHARMACEUTICALS ClarityMed SurgeonVision Pro
description:
The ClarityMed SurgeonVision Pro is a medical-grade bilateral ocular system purpose-built for surgical and diagnostic precision. Each unit houses a variable-focal crystalline lens capable of 120x optical magnification with sub-micron resolution, supported by a real-time tissue analysis overlay that color-codes biological structures — arteries, nerves, fascia layers, and malignant tissue — via spectroscopic wavelength parsing. An integrated vein-mapping suite projects a live 3D vasculature model into the surgeon's field of view, updating 60 times per second. Lazarus's proprietary BioSync coating minimizes rejection by mimicking the eye's natural extracellular matrix chemistry.

The SurgeonVision Pro is the standard of care in Meridian's Tier 4-5 hospital towers and is increasingly mandated for board-certified surgeons performing microsurgical procedures. Lazarus distributes exclusively through licensed medical channels, and the waiting list for certified installation runs 8-12 weeks at most facilities. A small number of units have found their way into black-market use among high-end body modders and tattoo artists who use the tissue overlay for precision dermal work.
installation_requirements: Board-certified ophthalmic surgeon; bilateral installation only; 72-hour post-op ocular pressure monitoring required
rejection_risk: Minimal — BioSync extracellular matrix coating is Lazarus's flagship anti-rejection technology; rejection rate under 1.2% in clinical trials
maintenance: Semi-annual recalibration at Lazarus-certified medical facility; spectroscopic filter replacement every 18 months

side_effects: Persistent overlay mode bleed — tissue classification overlays can spontaneously activate in daily life, making social interactions visually overwhelming
Magnification habituation: users report difficulty perceiving fine detail with the naked eye after extended use, creating functional dependency on the implant
Inductive charge port site occasionally causes low-grade dermal inflammation behind the ear
Rare reports of 'diagnostic intrusion' — users unconsciously analyzing the health of everyone they look at, causing significant empathy fatigue
cultural_context: In Meridian's medical hierarchy, a surgeon's ClarityMed installation is a career credential as much as a tool — visible proof of investment in one's practice. Lazarus leverages this by building the implant's serial number into the certification database, meaning a surgeon without a registered unit faces quiet professional skepticism. Among patients, knowing their surgeon has ClarityPros is a genuine comfort and a marketing point for high-end clinics.
known_users: Board-certified surgeons at Tier 4-5 hospital facilities
Microsurgical specialists and reconstructive cyberware surgeons
story_hooks: A Lazarus MedNet uplink vulnerability means every ClarityMed unit in the city has been passively recording surgical procedures — someone has been quietly building a database of every operation performed in Meridian for three years
A celebrated surgeon's SurgeonVision Pro begins misclassifying healthy tissue as malignant — either a firmware bug or deliberate sabotage — and patients are receiving unnecessary procedures

A player needs access to a restricted facility and learns that a ClarityMed-registered surgeon can bypass medical wing security — acquiring a stolen unit and spoofing the registration becomes the plan
